occupations.title: Laundry Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Laundry workers operate equipment and perform physical handling with minimal digital or information task components.

occupations.title: Other Cleaners
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Other cleaning is entirely hands-on physical labor with no meaningful exposure to digital or information tasks.

occupations.title: Building and Plumbing Labourers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Wholly physical work assisting tradies with materials, mixing concrete, and on-site support.

occupations.title: Concreters
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Physically laying and finishing concrete surfaces, intrinsically hands-on work.

occupations.title: Fencers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Physically installing fence posts, panels, and gates requiring manual labour.

occupations.title: Insulation and Home Improvement Installers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Physically installing insulation and weatherproofing materials with minimal information work.

occupations.title: Paving and Surfacing Labourers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Physically laying and finishing paving and asphalt surfaces.

occupations.title: Railway Track Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Physically laying and maintaining railway tracks with basic planning and measurement.

occupations.title: Structural Steel Construction Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Skilled physical work erecting, bolting, and welding structural steel.

occupations.title: Other Construction and Mining Labourers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Broadly physical work on construction sites and mining operations.

occupations.title: Food and Drink Factory Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Operating food production equipment and monitoring processes with routine quality checks.

occupations.title: Meat Boners and Slicers, and Slaughterers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Highly skilled manual precision work butchering, boning, and slicing meat.

occupations.title: Meat, Poultry and Seafood Process Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Operating meat processing machinery and handling materials with basic monitoring.

occupations.title: Packers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Repetitively packing items into containers with basic counting and packaging checks.

occupations.title: Product Assemblers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Assembling product components on production lines with quality verification and counting.

occupations.title: Metal Engineering Process Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Operating metal working machinery, finishing products, and performing routine inspection work.

occupations.title: Plastics and Rubber Factory Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Operating factory machinery and monitoring plastics and rubber production processes.

occupations.title: Product Quality Controllers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Inspecting and testing products, recording defects, classifying results, and entering quality data.

occupations.title: Timber and Wood Process Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Operating wood processing machinery like saws and planers with routine monitoring.

occupations.title: Other Factory Process Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Operating factory equipment and monitoring general production processes with basic checks.

occupations.title: Aquaculture Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Aquaculture work involves physical system maintenance, feeding, and monitoring with some data recording on stock and environmental conditions.

occupations.title: Crop Farm Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Crop farming combines physical field work (planting, harvesting, weeding) with occasional recording of yields and weather.

occupations.title: Livestock Farm Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Livestock care is primarily physical work (feeding, health checks, mucking) with minimal desk-based record-keeping.

occupations.title: Mixed Production Farm Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Mixed farming requires physical labor across crop and livestock operations with little information-processing content.

occupations.title: Forestry and Logging Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Logging and forestry work demands continuous on-site physical labor in unpredictable environments.

occupations.title: Garden Labourers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Garden labor involves digging, planting, weeding, and landscaping with no meaningful desk component.

occupations.title: Horticultural Nursery Assistants
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Nursery work is physically demanding (potting, propagating, watering) with occasional inventory and order management.

occupations.title: Pest Control Technicians
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Pest control requires on-site chemical application, equipment maintenance, and significant written reports on treatments.

occupations.title: Other Forestry and Garden Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Forestry and garden maintenance work is predominantly physical labor with minimal office work.

occupations.title: Fast Food Cooks
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Fast food cooking requires constant on-site physical work under time pressure with minor ordering and stock management.

occupations.title: Food Trades Assistants
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Food trades assistance is primarily hands-on food preparation and equipment handling with little documentation.

occupations.title: Kitchenhands
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Kitchen work consists of washing dishes, food prep, and sanitation with minimal record-keeping.

occupations.title: Freight and Furniture Handlers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Freight handling is entirely physical work loading, unloading, and moving goods in dynamic environments.

occupations.title: Shelf Fillers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Shelf filling involves stocking and rotating merchandise with basic inventory tracking.

occupations.title: Caretakers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Caretaker duties combine physical maintenance and cleaning with occasional inspection and maintenance reporting.

occupations.title: Deck and Fishing Hands
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Fishing and deck work are physically demanding operations requiring constant on-site presence in unpredictable conditions.

occupations.title: Handypersons
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Handyperson repairs and maintenance require on-site physical work and immediate problem-solving judgment.

occupations.title: Motor Vehicle Parts and Accessories Fitters
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Vehicle parts fitting is mostly hands-on installation, testing, and adjustment with minimal written documentation.

occupations.title: Printing Assistants and Table Workers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Printing assistants spend their time on hands-on equipment operation, paper feeding, cutting, and collation with no meaningful AI-touchable tasks.

occupations.title: Recycling and Rubbish Collectors
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Rubbish collection is entirely physical sorting and loading operations in varied environments where current AI tools cannot meaningfully assist.

occupations.title: Vending Machine Attendants
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: Vending machine attendants' work is mostly physical restocking and maintenance with only minor routine inventory tracking amenable to AI assistance.

occupations.title: Other Miscellaneous Labourers
occupations.ai_exposure_rationale: This catch-all category encompasses primarily physical general labor roles like packing and material handling with minimal desk-based information work.
